patch: UPDATE events SET start_at = replace(datetime(start_at, '+2 hours'), ' ', 'T'), end_at = replace(datetime(end_at, '+2 hours'), ' ', 'T'), updated_at = updated_at WHERE user_email = :email AND lower(title) LIKE '%improv%' AND date(start_at) = (SELECT date('now', '+' || (((10 - CAST(strftime('%w','now') AS INTEGER)) % 7) + 1) || ' days'))
probe: WITH thu AS (SELECT date('now', '+' || (((10 - CAST(strftime('%w','now') AS INTEGER)) % 7) + 1) || ' days') AS d) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events i JOIN events m ON m.id <> i.id, thu WHERE i.user_email = :email AND lower(i.title) LIKE '%improv%' AND date(i.start_at) = thu.d AND date(m.start_at) = thu.d AND i.start_at < m.end_at AND m.start_at < i.end_at AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM event_attendees a WHERE a.event_id = m.id AND a.email LIKE 'andy.bernard@%') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM event_attendees a WHERE a.event_id = m.id AND a.email LIKE 'jim.halpert@%')
